integrity: The proof normalizes the published laminar facet system in the intrinsic Euclidean metric, derives all frontier upper bounds, and proves matching feasibility by an independent recursive laminar allocation argument. The complete incenter set follows from the same normalized facet clearances. Finite LP replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to connected binary nestohedra with positive weights in the standard Euclidean realization, including connected fertilitopes. It does not assert an analogous frontier formula for arbitrary nonlaminar nestohedra and does not determine minimum-enclosing spheres or extremal ellipsoids. A general Chebyshev-center theorem for laminar generalized permutohedra under different terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: Connected fertilitopes have an exact frontier formula for their Euclidean inradius
